about: Arm clip packs made from authored humanoid clips by scripts/arm-clips (sample.py, then retarget.py). Source clips stay out of git: Mixamo's terms allow their use in the game but not passing the raw clips on, and the UAL source is kept beside it for the rebuild. A pack under content/held/models is in git; one here is not.

sources/mixamo/sword-and-shield-slash.fb.from: Adobe Mixamo, 'Sword And Shield Slash' on X Bot, downloaded 2026-10-31 from Patch's Mixamo account (Firefox on den-agents): FBX Binary, With Skin, 30 fps, no keyframe reduction, default trim and sliders
sources/mixamo/sword-and-shield-slash.fb.license: Mixamo terms: free to use in games; the animation files themselves are not redistributed

sources/ual/UAL1_Standard.glb.from: Quaternius Universal Animation Library (Standard), copied from rusty-craftsurvive/content/animations with its licence file

commands: python scripts/arm-clips/retarget.py mixamo.track.json content/held/models/psx-arms.glb content/held/models/psx-arms.knife.glb content/art/arms/psx-arms.mixamo-sword-slash.glb mixamo_sword_slash --facing 0:4 --band=-15,0,55,28 --gain 2.2 --reach 0.9 --clear 0.28 --push=0,-2,1 --sides R --sigma 0
psx-arms.mixamo-sword-slash.glb.marks: start 0.3 (frame 15, the dip under the rising cut begins), strike 0.44 (frame 22), recover 0.58 (frame 29, the cut done up and right), end 1
psx-arms.mixamo-sword-slash.glb.notes: A wind-up high, a dip, then a fast rising backhand cut. Staged by --band toward Dark Messiah's measured fast cuts (README, Reference): hand 44 right to 46 left, -55 to 10 up, elbow at least 0.31 m, on screen 71%. In game the dip goes below the frame and the rising cut passes close through the bottom right before finishing upper right.

commands: python scripts/arm-clips/retarget.py ual.track.json content/held/models/psx-arms.glb content/held/models/psx-arms.knife.glb content/held/models/psx-arms.ual-sword.glb ual_sword_attack --facing 0:4 --band=-15,0,55,28 --gain 2.2 --reach 0.9 --clear 0.28 --push=0,-2,1 --sides R --sigma 0
../../held/models/psx-arms.ual-sword.glb.marks: start 0, strike 0.243 (frame 9, the last raised frame), recover 0.297 (frame 11, the cut done low and left), end 0.81 (frame 30, settled after the flourish). The cut is one source frame (9 to 10); strike and recover bracket it so it spans the commit and crosses the view as the hit lands
../../held/models/psx-arms.ual-sword.glb.notes: Raise, fast downward cut across the body, a small flourish. Staged by --band: hand 41 right to 41 left, -51 to 5 up, elbow at least 0.31 m, on screen 68%. In game (in-game.sh, 33 ms steps) the cut crosses the view as the hit lands, the hand is below the frame for about 0.15 s early in the recovery, as Dark Messiah's cuts finish, and the flourish brings the blade back through the lower left by 0.33 s.
../../held/models/psx-arms.ual-sword.glb.sweep: blade-slash's hit path is baked from this clip on rift-blade: scripts/arm-clips/bake-sweep.sh blade-slash 1 5 --pitch=0.5 --write (2026-11-01). The drawn tip goes from 24 right, 36 up to 33 left, 30 down across the commit; at half its pitch the cut ends about 1.2 m up a body 1.6 m away (the drawn tip's would end at 0.7 m, the thigh)

sources/pinoc/pistol-fire.fbx.from: PINOC curated motion library, 'Pistol Fire' (asset 57dce1dd-7a52-4b31-b751-bcf78e90e085), Mixamo-rig FBX downloaded 2026-11-01 through the PINOC MCP
sources/pinoc/pistol-fire.fbx.license: PINOC library terms (free library clip); the file is not redistributed, so it and its pack stay out of git

commands: python scripts/arm-clips/retarget.py ual-idle.track.json content/held/models/psx-arms.glb content/held/models/psx-arms.knife.glb content/held/models/psx-arms.ual-pistol-idle.glb ual_pistol_idle --facing 0:4 --band=30,-24,10,8 --gain 1 --reach 0.85 --clear 0.28 --push=0,-2,1 --sigma 0 --sides R
../../held/models/psx-arms.ual-pistol-id.notes: The revolver family's idle (laser-flintlock on the PSX arms). Right arm only: UAL holds the pistol in both hands, and the left hand's open palm sat in front of the view; the empty left hand rests out of view instead.

commands: python scripts/arm-clips/retarget.py ual-shoot.track.json content/held/models/psx-arms.glb content/held/models/psx-arms.knife.glb content/held/models/psx-arms.ual-pistol-shoot.glb ual_pistol_shoot --facing 0:4 --band=30,-24,10,8 --gain 1 --reach 0.85 --clear 0.28 --push=0,-2,1 --sigma 0 --sides R
../../held/models/psx-arms.ual-pistol-sh.marks: start 0, strike 0.02, recover 0.067 (frame 1: the kick is the one-frame jump from frame 0), end 0.8. The landing (the shot) is the frame before the kick; Eject at recovery 0.1 and Cock at 0.8 are action events (content/actions)
../../held/models/psx-arms.ual-pistol-sh.notes: A small kick (0.06 m at the wrist) and a slow settle. In game (in-game.sh 16 ms) the landing and the kick are on update 4, Eject on update 8.

commands: python scripts/arm-clips/retarget.py ual-reload.track.json content/held/models/psx-arms.glb content/held/models/psx-arms.knife.glb content/held/models/psx-arms.ual-pistol-reload.glb ual_pistol_reload --facing 0:4 --band=30,-24,20,14 --gain 1 --reach 0.85 --clear 0.28 --push=0,-2,1 --sigma 0 --sides R,L
../../held/models/psx-arms.ual-pistol-re.marks: start 0, strike 0.55 (frame 22: the left hand slaps the magazine in), recover 0.6, end 0.95. Read from the left wrist: it leaves the gun at frame 2 (MagazineOut, windup 0.09), drops to the belt (frames 6 to 11), returns (12 to 16) and pushes up at 21 to 22. The refill lands at magazine-in because the strike mark is there
../../held/models/psx-arms.ual-pistol-re.notes: Both arms (clips.json leftHand lists flintlock-reload), so the empty left hand plays this clip instead of resting. Its fingers hold the base pose: no magazine in it.

commands: python scripts/arm-clips/retarget.py pinoc-fire.track.json content/held/models/psx-arms.glb content/held/models/psx-arms.knife.glb content/art/arms/psx-arms.pinoc-pistol-fire.glb pinoc_pistol_fire --facing 0:4 --band=30,-24,10,8 --gain 1 --reach 0.85 --clear 0.28 --push=0,-2,1 --sigma 0 --sides R
psx-arms.pinoc-pistol-fire.glb.marks: start 0, strike 0.053 (frame 2), recover 0.105 (frame 4: the kick), end 0.5
psx-arms.pinoc-pistol-fire.glb.notes: Compared on flintlock-shot 2026-11-01: a much bigger kick than UAL's (3.3 m/s at the wrist), with the arm held straight out and the gun small and far. UAL's stays the shot clip; switch flintlock-shot's clip in clips.json to try this one.
